Reproduced on its own: FAILED step 27 (reveal Kind in Shadow 1), 50pt short. Diagnosed with a temporary log in bringIntoReach: at the dock's top the Effects list showed 28 of its 283pt; Kind was inside the list's own viewport, just under the dock's bottom edge. The list took every turn (28pt is room for a 20pt row), each wheel turn overshot (asked 76, list ended 152 off), and six rounds oscillated. A scrollPanel diagnostic walk showed the dock scrolls the whole shadow into view, so the APP is right and the WALK is right: the harness's reveal was wrong. Fix 2b7c416a: PlaytestReach.turns puts a scroller whose own viewport already holds the control after the ones around it (unit tested).

left rough: scrollClip's wheel turn into the Effects list's SwiftUI scroller lands about twice the distance asked (76 asked, 152 travelled). Harmless now the dock takes that turn, and only a walk would ever notice, so no task; if a reveal oscillates again, this is why.
